# Chapter 1 — Form C bare quotes (no cast name in window)

The corridor was empty.

"I would prefer that we reconsider the entire arrangement before dawn."

"There is simply no acceptable path that leaves the outer gate unguarded."

"Every messenger we send across the bridge becomes another liability."

"If the ledger is wrong then the entire season of oaths collapses."

"Stand aside and let the watch rotate before the next bell."
